page.layout: One column of running text. Right margin with faint, damaged marginal notes, partly bled through from the reverse. Left margin blank. Running head at top right, page number 107 at top right.

main_text.p: Ita cum tenuiores cives voluptate spectandi pene privarentur, solis vero ditioribus theatra paterent, Pericles dicitur ad demerendam plebem decreti autor fuisse, ut spectare volentibus duo obuli (tanti enim sessiones singulae erant) id est, drachmae Atticae triens, quoties omnino spectare cupiebant, ex aerario darentur. Quo modo & aerarium inutiliter exhaustum, & plebis virtus militaris prope extincta fuit. Sed hoc de Pericle vix verisimile: aut si ab eo hoc captum, & ad tempus continuatum, sine dubio subnatis difficillimis bellis, quorum ipse praecipuus dux & author fuit, eo adhuc vivente rursum obsoletum. Verum cum quies civita[illegible, ~3 letters]tis denuo parta esset, & populus in diffi-[?]lutos mores ac voluptatum studium relaberetur, credibile, morem quoque illum à captatore gratiae popularis suggestu flagitante plebe in usum rediisse. Quem cum pestem reipublicae esse multi viderent & quererentur, tandem Apollodorus quidam, ut memoriae prodidit Vlpianus Demosthenis enarrato[illegible, ~4 letters] ausus fuit studio boni publici eum antiquare, & pecuniam illam theatrales[illegible, ~3 letters] (sic enim vocabatur) in usum stipendiorum militarium rursus convertere. Sed obstitit ei Eubulus tū rempub. fo-[?]

page.notes: Right margin: only faint fragments of marginal notes survive, mostly bled through in red from the reverse. Only the fragments I could partly make out are marked; the rest is not legible. Doubtful: "diffi-[?]lutos" at the line end, where the hyphen and the word stem are unclear; the scan may hold "dissolutos" or another word. "fo-" at the foot is partly lost; the printed hyphen is uncertain. The catchword "gerere" is at the lower right.
